subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw trust and adopt these 12 new action revisions in token-minting, publishing, security-scanning, and Codex-agent workflows after the branch is refreshed to current main?
rationale: The diff is mechanically consistent, but deciding whether newly pinned executable revisions may receive repository secrets and write-capable permissions is an owner-level supply-chain decision that checks cannot make.

options.title: Approve after refresh
options.body: Refresh onto current main, verify the upstream SHA-to-release mappings and exact-head checks, then approve the grouped update.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Land routine setup/scanner updates separately and review token, publishing, Blacksmith, and Codex action revisions in narrower PRs.

options.title: Decline this update set
options.body: Keep the existing pins and close this PR if owners do not want the new privileged action revisions.

recommendation.title: Approve after refresh
recommendation.body: Refresh onto current main, verify the upstream SHA-to-release mappings and exact-head checks, then approve the grouped update.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most strongly connects this person to the affected release, workflow-validation, and security surfaces.
